data.name: Nidhish
data.gender_notes: Nidhish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nidhish is the name of the Hindu god of wealth, known as Kubera. He is the ruler of Alakapuri, the city of gems. Nidhish is also the god of the serpents and is depicted with a mace and a bowl filled with gold or jewels. The name Nidhish carries the meaning “Lord of treasures” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nidhish usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of treasures and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nidhish belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of treasures.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nidhish total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: Nidhish is a name deeply rooted in Hindu culture, representing wealth, prosperity, and abundance. It is often invoked during prayers or rituals seeking financial success, fortune, and growing business opportunities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Nidhish is considered a symbol of trust, compassions, and wisdom. He is believed to have the power to bestow upon his devotees the blessings of abundance, prosperity, and financial security. Nidhish is also associated with the serpent gods, representing transformation, renewal, and the cyclical nature of life. Overall, the name "Nidhish" represents the hope and aspiration for material and spiritual prosperity, wealth, and well-being.
